examples.text: tassa pāde samajjantā, mukhañ'ca bhujadassanaṃ, saṃsumbhamānā attānaṃ, kālam'āgamayāmase.

11201.commentary: (MNa) āgamayamāno'ti olokayamāno. ahaṃ buddho'ti sahasā appavisitvā yāva sā kathā niṭṭhā'ti, tāva aṭṭhāsī'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assame dhammiyā kathāya sannisinnā honti. atha kho bhagavā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamāno.

11203.meaning1: (gram) insertion of a letter for the sake of euphony

examples.text: t'eva ariyasāvakassā'ti te ariyasāvakassa. vakāro āgamasandhimattaṃ hoti.

11204.meaning1: (gram) merely insertion of a letter for the sake of euphony

examples.text: t'eva ariyasāvakassā'ti te ariyasāvakassa. vakāro āgamasandhimattaṃ hoti.

11206.grammar: aor, reflx 1st sg of āgami, trans (+acc)

examples.text: evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passati.
anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.
sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā, sabbe bhūtā ca kevalā, sabbe bhadrāni passantu, mā kañci pāpam'āgamā.

11208.grammar: aor, reflx 2nd sg of āgami, trans (+acc)

examples.text: atha tvaṃ pavitakkam'āgamā, manasā diṭṭhigatāni cintayanto, dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātave'ti.
atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa aparena samayena vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena dvecattālīsaṃ dvecattālīsaṃ nāgasahassāni sakiṃ sakiṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ āgamaṃsu.

11211.commentary: (SNa) āgamaṃsu nu khv'idhā'ti āgamaṃsu nu kho idha.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho lohicco brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca, āgamaṃsu nu khv'idha, bho kaccāna, amhākaṃ sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakā'ti?
m'āvamaññetha pāpassa, na man'taṃ āgamissati, udabindunipātena, udakumbho'pi pūrati, bālo pūrati pāpassa, thokaṃ thokam'pi ācinaṃ.

atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ek'āyanena maggena tam'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ paṇidhāya. tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya, tath'āyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ'ca maggaṃ samārūḷho, yathā imaṃ'y'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ āgamissatī'ti.

11215.commentary: (VINa) vuṭṭhānam'assa āgametabban'ti gelaññato vuṭṭhānaṃ assa āgametabbaṃ, na katthaci gantabbaṃ. sace añño bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko atthi, bhesajjaṃ pariyesitvā tassa hatthe datvā bhante ayaṃ upaṭṭhahissatī'ti vatvā gantabbaṃ.

examples.text: na upajjhāyaṃ anāpucchā gāmo pavisitabbo, na susānaṃ gantabbaṃ, na disā pakkamitabbā. sace upajjhāyo gilāno hoti, yāvajīvaṃ upaṭṭhātabbo, vuṭṭhānam'assa āgametabban'ti.

11216.meaning1: should be waited; to be expected

11217.commentary: (MNa) āgamessāmī'ti udikkhissāmi, ajja apavāretvā yāva sā āgacchati, tāva katthaci agantvā idh'eva vasissāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, moggallāna, abbhutaṃ, moggallāna! yāva bāhāgahaṇā'pi nāma so moghapuriso āgamessatī'ti
sato, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sampajāno kālaṃ āgameyya. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī.
seyyathā'pi, udāyi, laṭukikā sakuṇikā pūtilatāya bandhanena baddhā tatth'eva vadhaṃ vā bandhaṃ vā maraṇaṃ vā āgameti.
aticiraṃ kho, bho, satta vassāni, n'āhaṃ sakkomi, bhavante, satta vassāni āgametuṃ. ko nu kho pana, bho, jānāti jīvitānaṃ!
n'etaṃ kho saraṇaṃ khemaṃ, n'etaṃ saraṇam'uttamaṃ, n'etaṃ saraṇam'āgamma, sabbadukkhā pamuccati.
so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ āgamma vineyya udakapipāsaṃ vineyya ghammapariḷāhaṃ

11225.grammar: ind, adv, ger of āgacchati, trans (+acc)

examples.text: ten'āyaṃ desito dhammo, khayagāmī anuttaro, tassa sāsanam'āgamma, labbhate taṃ asokatā.
evaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo. samantapāsādikaṃ, āvuso, puggalaṃ āgamma cittaṃ pasīdati.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chand'ūpasaṃhitā'pi dos'ūpasaṃhitā'pi moh'ūpasaṃhitā'pi, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tamhā nimittā aññaṃ nimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ.
ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto, saṅgamma rakkhissaṃ paresaṃ dhenuyo, tato ca āgā samaṇo mam'antike, gāvo ca māse agamaṃsu khādituṃ.
ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekacce sattā tamhā kāyā cutā āgāmino honti āgantāro itthattaṃ?
te ek'āgārikā vā honti ek'ālopikā, dv'āgārikā vā honti dv'ālopikā… satt'āgārikā vā honti satt'ālopikā. ekissā'pi dattiyā yāpenti, dvīhi'pi dattīhi yāpenti… sattahi'pi dattīhi yāpenti.

11234.meaning1: (while) being a householder, leading a householder's life; as a layperson

examples.text: abhabbo khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu sampajānamusā bhāsituṃ. abhabbo khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu sannidhikārakaṃ kāme paribhuñjituṃ, seyyathā'pi pubbe āgārikabhūto.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udake lekhā khippaṃ'y'eva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo āgāḷhena'pi vuccamāno pharusena'pi vuccamāno amanāpena'pi vuccamāno sandhiyati'm'eva saṃsandati'm'eva sammodati'm'eva.

11236.meaning1: is tired; is aching; is sore
11236.commentary: (MNa) piṭṭhi me āgilāyatī'ti kasmā āgilāyati? bhagavato hi chabbassāni padhānaṃ padahantassa mahantaṃ kāyadukkhaṃ ahosi, ath'assa aparabhāge mahallakakāle piṭṭhivāto uppajji.

examples.text: paṭibhātu taṃ, ānanda, kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ sekho pāṭipado. piṭṭhi me āgilāyati, tam'ahaṃ āyamissāmī'ti.
āguṃ na karoti kiñci loke, sabbasaṃyoge visajja bandhanāni, sabbattha na sajjatī vimutto, nāgo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ, ayaṃ te, deva, coro āgucārī, imassa yaṃ icchasi taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī'ti

11240.meaning1: who has committed a crime; criminal

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ, ayaṃ te, deva, coro āgucārī, imassa yaṃ icchasi taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī'ti

11241.meaning1: commits a crime; commits an offence; does a misdeed
11241.commentary: (THa) na hi āguṃ karoti so'ti āha. yasmā āguṃ, pāpaṃ, sabbena sabbaṃ na karoti

examples.text: nāgaṃ vo kittayissāmi, na hi āguṃ karoti so, soraccaṃ avihiṃsā ca, pādā nāgassa te duve.
āguṃ na karoti kiñci loke, sabbasaṃyoge visajja bandhanāni, sabbattha na sajjatī vimutto, nāgo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.
tass'eva kho pana pubbe aviddasuno āghāto hoti byāpādo sampadoso. sv'āssa pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
nava'y'ime, bhikkhave, āghātapaṭivinayā. katame nava? anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kut'ettha labbhā'ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.

11245.meaning2: having the essential function of causing irritation

examples.text: pāragū anupādāno, katakicco anāsavo, tuṭṭho āyukkhayā hoti, mutto āghātanā yathā.
seyyathā'pi saha bhaṇḍena gahitacoraṃ, vadhetha nan'ti rañño āṇāya rājapurisā bandhitvā catukke catukke pahārasatāni dentā āghātanaṃ nenti.

seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, gāvī vajjhā āghātanaṃ nīyamānā yaṃ yadeva pādaṃ uddharati, santik'eva hoti vadhassa santik'eva maraṇassa, evam'evaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, govajjh'ūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bah'upāyāsaṃ mantāyaṃ boddhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, n'atthi jātassa amaraṇan'ti.
nārī imā samparibhinnagattā, paggayha kandanti bhuje dujaccā, sammakkhitā lohitapubbalittā, gāvo yathā āghātane vikantā, tā bhūmibhāgasmiṃ sadā nikhātā, khandh'ātivattanti sajotibhūtā.

11248.meaning1: situated near a place of execution

examples.text: sārambhaṃ nāma… pubb'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, apar'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, abbhāghātanissitaṃ vā hoti, āghātananissitaṃ vā hoti, susānanissitaṃ vā hoti, uyyānanissitaṃ vā hoti

11249.commentary: (DNa) uddham'āghātanikā'ti āghātanaṃ vuccati maraṇaṃ, uddham'āghātanā attānaṃ vadantī'ti uddham'āghātanikā.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā uddham'āghātanikā saññīvādā uddham'āghātanaṃ saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti soḷasahi vatthūhi.
pañc'ime, āvuso, āghātapaṭivinayā yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo. katame pañca? idh'āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro.
nava'y'ime, bhikkhave, āghātapaṭivinayā. katame nava? anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kut'ettha labbhā'ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.

11254.meaning1: reason for resentment; grounds for animosity
11254.meaning2: occasion of ill-will; reason for resentment

examples.text: nava āghātavatthūni. anatthaṃ me acarī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati, anatthaṃ me caratī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati, anatthaṃ me carissatī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati, piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acarī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati

11257.meaning1: free from annoyance; devoid of irritation

11258.meaning1: holds a grudge; nurses a grievance

examples.text: nava āghātavatthūni. anatthaṃ me acarī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati, anatthaṃ me caratī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati, anatthaṃ me carissatī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati, piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acarī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati … anatthaṃ caratī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati …

11259.synonym: rosayati, roseti, viheṭhayati, viheṭheti, vihesati, viheseti
11259.commentary: (DNt) āghātetī'ti āhanati, attano kakkhaḷapharusabhāvena cittaṃ vibādhatī'ti attho. nissayadahanaraso hi doso.

examples.text: kopo hi cittaṃ āghātetī'ti āghāto. attano ca parassa ca hitasukhaṃ byāpādetī'ti byāpādo.

11260.meaning1: having harboured animosity (towards); having resented; having loathed

examples.text: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu ten'eva ābādhena kālam'akāsi. kālaṅ'kato ca kokāliko bhikkhu padumaṃ nirayaṃ upapajji sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā.

11263.meaning2: sips (water, for purification); rinses (one's mouth or one's body)

11264.notes: (MW) sipping water from the palm of the hand (before religious ceremonies, before meals, etc.) for purification

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, santikammaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ bhūtakammaṃ bhūrikammaṃ vassakammaṃ vossakammaṃ vatthukammaṃ vatthuparikammaṃ ācamanaṃ nhāpanaṃ juhanaṃ vamanaṃ

11266.meaning2: fixed shoes for the feet when washing

11267.meaning2: dish for holding water (for sipping or washing)

11268.meaning2: sips (water, for purification); rinses (one's mouth or one's body)

11269.meaning1: having washed one's hands and rinsed one's mouth; having performed preparatory ablutions

11270.meaning1: having washed one's hands and rinsed one's mouth; having performed preparatory ablutions
11270.commentary: (ANa) sayaṃ ācamayitvānā'ti attanā'va hatthapāde dhovitvā mukhaṃ vikkhāletvā.

11272.meaning1: rinses; washes; (comm) gives water for rinsing
11272.commentary: (MNa) ācamehī'ti ācamanodakaṃ dehi. ācamitvā hatthapāde dhovitvā mukhaṃ vikkhāletvā satthāraṃ namassitu'kāmo evam'āha.

examples.text: ehi, mallike, ācamehī'ti
ācayāya saṃvattanti no apacayāya.
dissati, bhikkhave, imassa cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa ācayo'pi apacayo'pi ādānam'pi nikkhepanam'pi.

11275.meaning2: setting up (one of the kinds of upādā-rūpa)

11278.meaning2: leading to accumulation; leading to growth

11279.meaning1: increase and decrease; accumulation and diminution (of); enlargement and reduction
11279.commentary: (MNa) ācay'āpacayo hotī'ti vaḍḍhi ca avaḍḍhi ca hoti, iti imassa kāyassa kālena vaḍḍhi, kālena parihānī'ti vaḍḍhiparihānimattam'eva paññāyati

examples.text: yaṃ kho te, aggivessana, purimaṃ pahāya pacchā upacinanti, evaṃ imassa kāyassa ācay'āpacayo hoti

11280.synonym: abhisaṅkharoti, iriyati, karoti, carati, pakubbati, samācarati

examples.text: muṭṭhīhi'pi yujjhanti, raṅgamajjhe'pi saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vadanti, idha, bhagini, naccassū'ti, nalāṭikam'pi denti, vividham'pi anācāraṃ ācaranti.
kim'idaṃ kusalaṃ kim'ācarema, icc'eke hi samecca mantayanti, te mayaṃ punareva laddha mānusattaṃ, paṭipannā viharemu sīlavanto.
sacce ca dhamme ca dame ca saṃyame, soceyyasīl'ālay'uposathesu ca, dāne ahiṃsāya asāhase rato, daḷhaṃ samādāya samattam'ācari.
paribbaja mahābrahme, pacant'aññe'pi pāṇino, mā tvaṃ adhammo ācarito, asmā kumbham'iv'ābhidā'ti.

11284.meaning1: wanting to engage; wanting to indulge (in)

examples.text: uyyojeyyā'ti mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitu'kāmo kīḷitu'kāmo raho nisīditu'kāmo anācāraṃ ācaritu'kāmo evaṃ vadeti, gacch'āvuso, na me tayā saddhiṃ kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hoti
uyyojeyyā'ti mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitu'kāmo kīḷitu'kāmo raho nisīditu'kāmo anācāraṃ ācaritu'kāmo evaṃ vadeti, gacch'āvuso, na me tayā saddhiṃ kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hoti

11286.meaning1: having acted; having behaved; having performed; having practised
11286.commentary: (VINa) dutiyasikkhāpade, anācāraṃ ācaritvā'ti akātabbaṃ katvā, kāyavacīdvāresu āpattiṃ āpajjitvāti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: evaṃ vadeyyā'ti anācāraṃ ācaritvā, aññāṇakena āpanno'ti jānantū'ti pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeti, idān'eva kho ahaṃ jānāmi, ayam'pi kira dhammo sutt'āgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evam'assa, antevāsikamyatā no samaṇo gotamo evam'āhā'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. yo eva vo ācariyo, so eva vo ācariyo hotu.
ime kho, bhikkhave, dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ na pāleyyuṃ, na'y'idha paññāyetha mātā'ti vā mātucchā'ti vā mātulānī'ti vā ācariyabhariyā'ti vā garūnaṃ dārā'ti vā.
ācariyo me bhante hohi āyasmato nissāya vacchāmi
upasampādessāmī'ti gaṇaṃ vā ācariyaṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati, sīmaṃ vā sammannati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā.

ehi tvaṃ, samma medakathālike, caṇḍālavaṃsaṃ abhiruhitvā mama uparikhandhe tiṭṭhāhī'ti. evaṃ, ācariyā'ti kho, bhikkhave, medakathālikā antevāsī caṇḍālavaṃsikassa paṭissutvā caṇḍālavaṃsaṃ abhiruhitvā ācariyassa uparikhandhe aṭṭhāsi.

11292.meaning1: belonging to a teacher; of a school

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.
vihaññati kho ayaṃ soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo sakena cittena. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyyan'ti
na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti… sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti
sace me, bhante, assadammo saṇhena vinayaṃ na upeti, pharusena vinayaṃ na upeti, saṇhapharusena vinayaṃ na upeti, hanāmi naṃ, bhante. taṃ kissa hetu? mā me ācariyakulassa avaṇṇo ahosī'ti.

11295.meaning2: family or the abode of a teacher

11296.meaning1: position of teacher; place of spiritual leader

examples.text: iti kho, aggivessana, udako rāmaputto sabrahmacārī me samāno ācariyaṭṭhāne ca maṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.

11297.meaning1: payment for a teacher; teacher's fee
11297.commentary: (MNa) ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesissantī'ti aññatitthiyā hi yassa santike sippaṃ uggaṇhanti, tassa sipp'uggahaṇato pure vā pacchā vā antar'antare vā gehato nīharitvā dhanaṃ denti. yesaṃ gehe n'atthi, te ñātisabhāgato pariyesanti, tathā alabhamānā bhikkham'pi caritvā denti'y'eva. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: imehi nāma, bhante, aññatitthiyā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesissanti, kim'aṅgaṃ pan'āhaṃ āyasmato ānandassa pūjaṃ na karissāmī'ti!

11298.meaning1: teacher and student; master and apprentice
11298.commentary: (DNa) it'iha te ubho ācariy'antevāsī'ti evaṃ te dve ācariy'antevāsikā.

examples.text: itiha te ubho ācariy'antevāsī aññam'aññassa ujuvipaccanīkavādā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhā honti bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca.
